svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.ireland-flag-layout-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introduced Ireland national-flag layout: 3 equal vertical bands, green/white/orange from left hoist to right fly, height:length 1:2. Frame [180, 90]mm on [220, 130]mm page. Boundaries convey equal regions;colour andidentity depend on the external key. Accessible teacher/audio key introduces ireland,orientation vertical left-hoist to right-fly,colour roles green, white, orange. Height:length 1:2, supported by Irish government and Defence Forces descriptions. Country and colour roles require an accessible teacher/audio key. Native grey fills do not intrinsically encode hue; independent ratio-based layout, not exact original template reproduction.", "native_tip_geometry": null, "native_curve_parameters": null, "geometry_exception": "Index native1.2mm outline samples with3.1mm guard;declared boundary/frame contacts coalesce. Compatible continuous band-boundary paths shared between Swell/ViewPlus. No medium geometry exception beyond native sampling. Colour/identity introduced byexternal accessible key.", "band_regions": [{"id": "band-1", "colour_role": "green", "rectangle_mm": [20.0, 20, 60.0, 90]}, {"id": "band-2", "colour_role": "white", "rectangle_mm": [80.0, 20, 60.0, 90]}, {"id": "band-3", "colour_role": "orange", "rectangle_mm": [140.0, 20, 60.0, 90]}], "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native outline sampling retains declared logicalboundary/frame contacts. 1.2mm native line samples;3.1mm minimum centre guard;logicalpartcontactsshare samples;anchors preserved;all additional samples guarded at3.1mm;maximum path step documented;physicalcontinuity andreaderrecognition pending.
